summary: GitLab is a self-hosted platform for software development and project management. It provides tools for Git repository management, code reviews, issue tracking, activity feeds, and wikis in a single web interface.
goodFor: Development teams wanting a comprehensive, self-hosted workspace to manage source code and track project tasks on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: Deploying and maintaining an all-in-one software development platform of this scale typically demands significant server resources and ongoing operational overhead.
deployNotes: You can typically run this software using Docker or Kubernetes, which usually requires configuring persistent storage volumes for your repository data and database.
